en: Double time!
Ribbit! No!! This cannot...ribbit...be! You have duped me with...ribbit...your foul trickery! Ribbit!
Thank you for this report, $n.  It is now clear that we must tighten our patrols near Theramore.
Nope, no alchemists out here in Dun Morogh.  Ye best take a look in Ironforge for them... try the gnomes in Tinker Town.
%s gestures at the piles of books.
YARRR! Swabie, what have ye done?! He's gone mad! Baton down the hatches! Hoist the mast! ARRRR! Every man for hi'self!
Now... where was my thread and needle. Ah! There it is...
%s attacks!
Feed you to master!

$g Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat. : Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!;
Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Push them back to their base! Let not a single Alliance soldier remain living on this battlefield!
And I am determined to find out more... So if you need my help again, you know where I'll be.

Kelstrum is a loudmouth and a braggart... and if that weren't enough he's also one of the most skilled warriors ye'll ever meet!  

I tell ye, if ye're looking to be trained in the ways of a warrior, that's who ye should be talking to.  I'm sure he can be found over in the Hall of Arms east of the Gates of Ironforge.
Please... please... Miss Proudmore. I didn't mean to...
Night, night.
Be sure to tell Greatfather Winter what secret surprise you'd like to get this Winter Veil!
I hereby destroy these instruments of evil! For the Horde!
This job is definitely not worth sixteen-five a year.

Excellent!  You shall be doing the League of Arathor a great service in ridding Arathi Basin of The Defilers and their Horde thugs.  Seek out the Lady Hoteshem in the royal audience chamber of Stormwind Keep.  She has been expecting you, $n.
YOU ARE THE WINNER!
You're doing very well in the art of tailoring, I must admit. Now, let's see how good you REALLY are...
Hm...after dropping this off, I think I'll head to that cheese shop for a snack.
I hope that was a fish!
This desert be mine!

How many metal bars you say? As of my last update on the situation, here is what I know. The Horde has collected $2018w copper bars out of $1998w needed, $2005w tin bars out of $2006w and of $2009w mithril bars sought, $2008w have been gathered.
What a wonderful day to be alive! Look at the beauty that surrounds you, friend. Enjoy what life has to give!
I'm glad the commotions died down some around here. The last thing this place needs is another brawl.
Now we just need to figure out how to get this thing working again.
$n claims the farm!  If left unchallenged, the Horde will control it in 1 minute!
Just /lay down anywhere, $n. I promise, this won't hurt a bit!
There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.
A simple enough task to break this soulstone!
When I get all shaken up, hear me shout...

Don't let those big, innocent eyes fool ye. Tally's an expert, all right: I learn something new every day. Why d'you think I'm here in Tinker Town? Do I look like an engineer to you? Aye, I didn't think so.
